title: PFRDA Opens On-Tap Registration for Pension Fund Managers under NPS
summary: Allows eligible asset managers to apply continuously for managing National Pension System funds.

blocks.content: Allows eligible asset managers to apply continuously for managing National Pension System funds.

items: Eligibility Thresholds: Minimum 5 years fund management experience, Net worth ≥ ₹50 crore for past 5 years, Paid-up capital ≥ ₹25 crore.
Regulatory Oversight: Applicant must be regulated by RBI, SEBI, or IRDAI.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: PFRDA Chairman: Deepak Mohanty | Established 2003 | HQ: New Delhi.

blocks.content: PFM net worth requirement (₹50 crore) vs paid-up capital requirement (₹25 crore).
